note: The table items: cosmetic platform items only the server grants. The one place a table's slug, id and title live; read by src/net/tables.ts (the game), tools/server/make-config.mts (the game config) and functions/checker/build.rs (which board grants which table). An id never changes once uploaded. The onboarding table's "coins" is the onboarding prize paid with it (board "board", once): the game shows it up front, and the config pays it. The built-in snowy dusk table (table-winter-dusk) is every player's and is no item.
